theme: The smallest machine that does the job
title: The Smallest Machine That Does The Job
strategies: correct-but-padded residue automaton: recover the true residue law from the samples, then represent each residue as a (residue, redundant counter) pair without checking whether the counter is ever needed
bounded recent-context window: assume behaviour depends only on the last few bits read (a fixed 16-state sliding window), fit each window's decision by majority vote from the samples

candidate-modulus search + behaviour-equivalence minimization: find the smallest modulus fully consistent with every sample, then Moore-refine the resulting automaton to merge residues that are truly behaviourally indistinguishable
non-halting decoy: a single self-looping state that never reaches ACCEPT/REJECT
